artifact_observations.location: Earphone cable near the jack plug
artifact_observations.reasoning: The white plastic housing of the earphone jack plug appears melted or deformed, lacking the rigid geometric structure of a real 3.5mm connector. It blends slightly into the cable.
The cable exhibits inconsistent thickness and slight 'fusion' where loops touch, lacking distinct shadow separation in tight coils.
The right bezel of the iPod seems to warp slightly inward rather than maintaining a straight parallel line with the left edge, suggesting minor geometric instability.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific model generation (Classic vs Nano vs Touch) and verify it matches the 'iPod' class label accurately.
To verify the physical separation between the iPod and the book surface, ensuring the device isn't 'floating' or melting into the background texture.
To audit the complex topology of the tangled cable for breaks, fusions, or impossible self-intersections.
To assess overall rendering quality, lighting consistency, and detect subtle noise or blur artifacts.

focus_areas: Structural integrity of the earphone jack plug
Continuity and separation of the tangled cable loops
Straightness and parallelism of the iPod's rectangular edges
Clarity and legibility of the screen UI text/icons
Contact shadows between the iPod and the leather book
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the earphone jack; AI often fails to render the rigid plastic/metal transition of 3.5mm plugs correctly, resulting in melting. Also, check if the screen content is generic gibberish or recognizable iPod UI elements. Verify that the reflection on the iPod's screen matches the ambient lighting of the scene.
